The Facts, in short, are that the respondent No.1 borrowed Tk.50,000,00/-from respondent No.3-Standard Chartered Bank and mortgaged the property mentioned in schedule A of the plaint of Title Suit No.35 of 1996 renumbered as Title Suit No. 261 of 1999 and the borrower defaulted in repaying the loan and so the aforesaid bank filed the above suit for realizing the money and obtained a decree of, Tk.1,45,61,562/- and decree holder bank instituted Execution Case No.23 of 1999 for recovery of the money by putting the aforesaid property in public auction and the auction took place on 02.09.2002 and the petitioner auction purchased the property. The judgment debtor alleging irregularities in holding auction filed Miscellaneous Case No.10 of 2004 praying to set aside auction sale dated 02.09.2002. The decree holder bank contested the case filing written objection. The present petitioner i. e. auction purchaser also contested the aforesaid miscellaneous case by filing written objection denying the allegations of the judgment debtor. The learned Judge Artha Rin Adalat by judgment and order dated 17.02.2005 dismissed the miscellaneous case with costs. The judgment debtors being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and order of the learned judge of the Artha Rin Adalat filed First Miscellaneous appeal No.66 of 2005. The High Court Division by Order dated 29.03.2005 admitted the appeal for hearing and stayed further proceedings of Artha Rin Adalat Execution Case No.80 of 2005 for one month from dated. Hence is this Petition. 

 5. Mr. Khandker Mahbubuddin Ahmed learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the respondent No.1 on the other hand submits that Miscellaneous Case No.10 of 2004 was dismissed by 4th Artha Rin Adalat on 17.02.2005 and this respondent applied on the same day for certified copy. Case was transferred to 3rd Artha Rin Adalat, Dhaka, Folio was not assessed till 03.03.2005. So, second application for copy was filed on 03.03.2005 in the 3rd Artha Rin Adalat wherein folio was assessed on 05.03.2005 and copy was delivered on 07.03.2005. F.M.A.T. against the Order dated 17.02.2005 was filed with that certified copy on 19.03.2005. The appeal was, therefore, filed within 30 (thirty) days i. e. within the period of limitation and that the question is, what is the "time requisite for obtaining certified copy" in this case? Since copy was applied for on 17.02.2005 and copy was delivered on 07.03.2005, time requisite for obtaining certified copy is 18 (eighteen) days. So, the appeal be within time if it would be filed within (30+18) = 48 days from 17.02.2005 i. e. 06.04.2005.
